hook: A man plugged Claude into his 32-year-old Jeep. Then it started *controlling the engine*
caption:
His 1994 Jeep Cherokee kept failing California's smog test, about $100 a try, and it has no port normal scanners can read.
With a cheap Arduino and three wires, Claude worked out the engine computer's old protocol, read live data and even ran the fuel pump. Codex helped write a program into its memory.
The Jeep passed.
